visualCharacteristics.purpose: Full-width photo with a teal heading tab above the photo edge and a white bordered text panel overlapping the photo on one side

contentPattern.structure: One row with two cells: an image cell (photo + alt) and a text cell (heading, paragraph(s) with inline links, optional standalone 'Find out more' link). The cell order sets the panel side: [image | text] = panel on the right, [text | image] = panel on the left.

reuseGuidance: Use for a single featured story told over a wide photo (e.g. Britannia Club, Discover unique experiences). Each panel is one block; swap the cell order to put the panel on the other side. For several equal offers side by side use columns-promo.
